reuse.why: Takes its categories from the shared getMonthWideTargetCategories and registers through the same mutator(undoable(...)) wiring; reads spending via getSheetValue like the average code.

duplication.why: Repeats the per-action 'is_income && !isTrackingBudget()' skip and the income/expense sign flip that setNMonthAvg already does inline, rather than sharing them.

placement.why: Action lives in budget/actions.ts beside the other month-wide actions and the handler is registered in budget/app.ts next to its siblings.

scope.why: Only the new action, its registration and tests.

maintainability.why: Short and consistent with neighbouring actions; the copied income skip and sign rule are small but add another place to update.

disguised_duplication.where: budget/actions.ts setLastMonthSpending: the income-vs-expense sign rule from setNMonthAvg (avg *= -1 when not income) reappears reshaped as 'is_income === 1 ? netActivity : 0 - netActivity'
